title: The Civilian Front
description: Sixty thousand displaced. Bread shortages projected in three weeks. The war is not just military — it is a test of whether the society holds together.

title: The Return
description: Veltrian soil — reached by fishing vessel at night. The textile mill outside Kravenstal has become a headquarters. The country is waiting to see whether you come back as liberator or footnote.

title: The Reform Backlash
description: The Halvekists, the Iron Covenant, the Church, the business class — all of them are pushing back. The question is not whether reform faces resistance. It's whether you compromise or crush.

title: Budget Allocation — Decisive Phase
description: The situation is critical on every front. The budget must reflect the priorities that will define your legacy — military victory, reform completion, regime survival, or national reconstruction.

title: Dravenni — War Alliance
description: The DLF has committed forces to the war effort. Their conditions: formal autonomy recognition, language rights, and parliamentary seats. Brenner thinks they're useful. Kolvar thinks they're traitors. Both assessments are military calculations dressed as political ones.

title: Ceasefire — Preliminary Talks
description: Back-channel communications with Tyvaren have produced a tentative framework. Neither side wants to be seen asking first. The question is whether you can afford to let the war continue while saving face.

title: BCA Report
description: The Bureau of Civic Accountability has submitted its final report.

title: SSD Report
description: The State Security Directorate has submitted its final report.

title: The Loyal Force
description: The Commissioner has requested a meeting without stating a reason. In thirty-seven weeks, they have always stated a reason.
